# Security Policy

The project team takes security issues seriously. We appreciate your efforts to responsibly disclose your findings, and we will make every effort to acknowledge your contributions.

## Supported Versions

Use this table to see which versions of the project are currently supported with security updates. If you are using an unsupported version, please upgrade to a supported version.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| `v.x` | :white_check_mark: |
| `v.x.x` | :white_check_mark: |
| `vxx` | :x:                |


## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.**

If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it to us privately. This gives us the opportunity to fix the issue before it is widely known.

### Private Reporting Methods

1.  **GitHub Security Advisories (Preferred):** The best way to report a vulnerability is directly on GitHub using the private vulnerability reporting feature.
    * **[Click here to submit a new private report](https://github.com/treeofmapple/YOUR_REPOSITORY/security/advisories/new)**

2.  **Email:** If you are unable to use GitHub, you can send your report to us at `patoincomum@gmail.com`.

### What to Expect

When you report a vulnerability, we will:
* Acknowledge receipt of your report within 48 hours.
* Provide an initial assessment of the vulnerability's severity and impact.
* Keep you informed of our progress as we work on a fix.
* Coordinate a disclosure date with you once a patch is ready.
* Publicly credit you for your discovery, unless you prefer to remain anonymous.

We thank you for helping keep our project and its users safe.
